name: co-op claims + street postcards

product.co_op_claims: Prepare brand-rule checklists and dealer-authorized claim drafts from ad proofs and invoices. A claim is never filed unless the dealer authorizes it and the approval step is completed.
product.street_postcards: Prepare 6x4 neighborhood postcard proofs for local dealers and shared business cards. Mail runs in Lob test mode only until the owner supplies test credentials and approves the campaign.
product.budget_timing: Open dealer outreach and postcard campaigns in November so dealers can use current year-end co-op budgets; calculate brand claim reminders 60 and 30 days before each program expiry.

schedules.purpose: Check local claim intake for upcoming program expiries and 60/30-day reminders.
Open the annual dealer year-end postcard preparation cycle in November.

your_steps.title: Connect Jobber for the co-op app
your_steps.detail: Create the Glacier app in the Jobber Developer Center and request read-only completed-job access. Paste the Jobber values and optional Lob test key into the labeled fields on this step. Glacier saves them in this computer's keychain. Keep brand portal credentials separate for each brand, and add them only after confirming that brand permits portal use. Leave the callback blank until Glacier has its real URL.

your_steps.title: Review the first brand claim
your_steps.when: Before the first claim for each brand
your_steps.detail: Confirm that the brand's program rules are represented correctly, review the evidence checklist, and approve the dealer-authorized claim draft. Any government filing remains for the customer to sign and submit.

your_steps.title: Choose routes and approve the first postcard
your_steps.when: Before the first November mail run
your_steps.detail: Choose the towns/routes, approve the exact card proof and budget, and configure Lob test mode plus a printer/post-office plan. The flow never sends live mail.

launch_gates: First claim per brand is reviewed by the owner; each dealer separately authorizes its claim.
First postcard design and each list's first send are owner-approved; Lob must use a test_ key.
No homeowner name is collected or printed on street cards; completed job addresses are street-level only.
A category can appear once per shared route card, and every ad requires written approval.
No claim with missing required pre-approval or evidence can proceed to the filer.
